compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from an app that allows users to save searches and receive notifications. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Header Section**:
   - Title: "Saved Searches"
   - Icons: Settings (gear icon) and Add (plus icon)

2. **Main Content**:
   - Notification Icon: A bell symbol indicating notifications.
   - Title: "Get notified in real time"
   - Description: "Get notified as soon as new listings hit the market and be the first to contact the seller"
   - Action Button: "Create your first saved search" (blue button)

3. **Additional Feature**:
   - Section Title: "Smart Alert"
   - Description: "View recommended vehicles based on your previous searches"
   - Notification Badge: A small badge with the number "0" indicating no current alerts.
